fire: The clerk looked up and said, "So, Mr. Doyle, how can I help?"
The servants told him: "Sir, the horses are ready."
She knelt and whispered: "Please, my lady, forgive us."
Anna grinned at him. "Well, Dr. Reyes, shall we begin?"
The old man said to them: "Friends, hear me out."
He took her coat. "Oh, Mrs. Lane, you shouldn't have."
The messenger bowed and said, "Sire, the bridge has fallen."
They turned to the judge and said, "Your Honor, we object."
quiet: The clerk looked up and said, "The office closes at five today."
The servants told him that the horses were ready.
She knelt and whispered a short prayer for the family.
Anna grinned at him. "I think we should begin."
The old man said that his friends would come later.
Mrs. Lane took her coat and went out to the car.
The messenger bowed and said, "The bridge has fallen."
The judge turned to them and said nothing at all.

short: address at the start of a spoken line
